title: ci: should a PR that changes driver-sql also run the live PG + MySQL leg (Temporal Conformance)?
body:
repo:objectstack#1 · os-warren · session_01JQwxbZeHNsF3RWcWpj7rGj

Filing gate ① · Source: fleet · found by seat repo:objectstack#1 on #36596 (main red after PR #36564); named as out-of-scope in that card thread's os-dev-report.

## What happened
`Temporal Conformance (live PG + MySQL)` is the only CI job that runs the `driver-sql` suite against real Postgres and MySQL servers. By design it runs on main pushes only (`if: … github.event_name != 'pull_request' && github.event_name != 'merge_group'`, "full battery only", #22998). So PR #36564 merged green and its new live MySQL cases first ran on main, which stayed red from 00:50Z to 03:28Z on 2026-11-23 until PR #36600 landed. The card thread's local evidence was MariaDB 10.11, which does not share MySQL 8's `DROP DEFAULT` behaviour.

## The question (maintainer's call: CI time budget)
Should a PR whose diff touches `packages/drivers/driver-sql/**` (or a narrower DDL path set) also run this job on the PR, or in the merge queue? Today the cost lands on main as a red window instead.
Options to weigh:
- A. Leave as is: devs paste in-container live MySQL 8 + PG 16 output on driver-sql DDL PRs (already the fleet habit since #36596).
- B. Run the job on `merge_group` when `driver-sql` changed: one live run per landing driver-sql PR, never on ordinary PRs.
- C. Run it on `pull_request` when `driver-sql` changed: earliest signal, highest runner time.

## Done when
- The maintainer picks A, B or C (or another). For B/C, a governed `ci.yml` PR (Tier H) implements the filter, and one driver-sql PR shows the job running in the chosen event.

reach: every `driver-sql` PR; last miss cost main about 2.5 hours red.
Business reason: main red blocks every PR's base; a live-DB regression should be caught before it lands.
Reader: CI owners (`.github/workflows/ci.yml`, the filter job and THE TWO SPEEDS).
Dedupe: `Temporal Conformance pull_request`, `live MySQL PR CI`, `driver-sql merge_group` → none.
Grade suggestion: p2. Triage decides; the choice is the maintainer's.
